item.title: Carney Rallies Remain Vote in Alberta
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney urged voters in Alberta to reject separatism in a referendum next week.

item.title: IEA Agrees to Release of Outstanding 100MM Oil Barrels
item.description: The International Energy Agency said that member countries agreed to complete the release of 100 million barrels of oil that are still outstanding from an intervention in March.

item.description: GlobalData offered its view in a statement sent to Rigzone this week.

item.title: US FERC proposes blanket permit programme for LNG facilities
item.description: The US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has put forward the first blanket authorisation programme for liquefied natural gas (LNG) facilities through a unanimously backed Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NOPR).

item.title: OPEC+ Meets on Sidelines of Saudi Conference
item.description: 'The Ministers reviewed market conditions', a statement posted on OPEC's website said.

item.title: BW Energy reports 8–9mbbl find in Dussafu appraisal wells in Gabon
item.description: BW Energy has announced that recent appraisal drilling on the Dussafu field offshore Gabon has identified commercial oil volumes, with an estimated combined gross recovery of approximately 8-9 million barrels (mbbl).

item.title: Currie Calls Brent 'Vibe Contract' Out of Step with Energy
item.description: The world's most important oil benchmark has become little more than a 'vibe contract', according to Wall Street veteran Jeff Currie.

item.title: China Builds Gas Buffer for Winter
item.description: China has stockpiled enough natural gas to meet winter demand, according to analysts.

item.title: Essar Oil & Gas wins five new CBM blocks across three Indian states
item.description: Indian coal bed methane (CBM) operator Essar Oil & Gas has been awarded five exploration blocks covering approximately 1,281km2 across West Bengal, Madhya Pradesh and Telangana in India.
